project_id.description: Project this run was performed against

result.description: Outcome of the run. 'escalated' = operator took over after agent was blocked.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of what was accomplished

eval_failures.description: List of eval test names that failed (e.g., 'test_mining.py::TestZeroKnownFailures::test_scue_tests_all_pass'). Used for flakiness analysis across runs.

backfilled.description: Whether this record was retroactively created

time_to_operator_response.description: Minutes from first operator-gated checkpoint (spec approval, plan approval, AskUserQuestion) to operator response. Null if no checkpoint occurred. Populate at task close by checking session timestamps.

operator_interventions.description: Number of times the operator intervened (corrections, re-directions, scope changes) during this run. 0 means fully autonomous.

agent_escalations.description: Number of times the agent escalated to the operator (AskUserQuestion, blocked result, incident log). Measures agent uncertainty.
